# Command reference {#sec-command-reference}

This quick reference aggregates frequently used commands from the manual pages.

## Global launcher

```bash
c5dec -h
c5dec -t
c5dec -g
```

## CCT

```bash
c5dec view <ID>
c5dec validate -d <IDs>
c5dec checklist -c <prefix> --id <IDs> --info <info>
c5dec checklist <prefix> --validate
c5dec export <name> <version> -p <components>
c5dec etr -f <families> -t <tables>
```

## SSDLC and publishing

```bash
c5dec new -p <project_name> -u <user_directory>
poetry run doorstop
cd docs/specs && ./publish.sh
```

## PM

```bash
c5dec timerep <openproject-export.xlsx>
c5dec consolidate <input-folder>
c5dec costrep <timesheet.xlsx>
```

## CPSSA

```bash
c5dec cpssa create-threat-model --project <project>
c5dec cpssa generate-report --model <model>
c5dec cpssa generate-dfd --project <project>
c5dec cpssa fair-input --model <model>
c5dec cpssa risk-analysis --model <model> --fair-params <params>
```

## Cryptography

```bash
c5dec crypto hash <file>
c5dec crypto verify-hash <file> <hash>
c5dec crypto sign <file> -o <signature>
c5dec crypto verify-sig <file> <signature>
c5dec crypto encrypt <file> -r <recipient>
c5dec crypto decrypt <file.gpg> -o <file>
c5dec crypto shamir-split <secret_hex> -n <n> -k <k>
c5dec crypto shamir-recover <share1> <share2> <share3>
c5dec crypto nacl-keygen
c5dec crypto nacl-sign <message> <signing_key_hex>
c5dec crypto nacl-verify <signed_hex> <verify_key_hex>
```

## CRA and SBOM

```bash
c5dec cra --create --prefix <prefix> [--category default|class_i|class_ii|critical]
c5dec cra --verify [--prefix <prefix>]
c5dec cra --export <report.xlsx>
c5dec sbom generate <target> -o <sbom.json> -f cyclonedx|spdx
c5dec sbom import <sbom.json> --prefix <prefix> --version <version>
c5dec sbom diff <sbom1> <sbom2> -o <diff.md>
c5dec sbom validate <prefix>
c5dec docengine cra-tech-doc -n <output_name>
```

## Notes

- Some commands assume a Poetry-activated environment.
- Some rendering and publishing paths assume Quarto and LaTeX dependencies are installed.
- The manual notes that `c5dec publish` is currently feature-flagged off.
